name: Addon statistics - Invoicing Tab
description:
**Why?**
The new Shoptet Partner Portal (Figma: Moje doplňky → Statistiky doplňků) needs to show partners their addon **invoicing** stats (Fakturace tab). Today that data only exists inside the admin's API Partner section (`ApiPartnerController`, views `statsSummaryView`/`statsDetailView`).

**What?**
Extract the addon-statistics logic from `ApiPartnerController` into its own standalone controller so the same screen/data serves both the existing admin section and the new Partner Portal — without duplicating the implementation. The admin's API Partner → Statistiky screen keeps working exactly as today (same tables, columns, footnote definitions), just backed by the new controller. The Partner Portal exposes the "Statistiky doplňků" screen's **Fakturace** tab per the linked Figma design, reusing that controller.

Pozn.: Použitelnost (usability) tab je řešen samostatně v CZ3TDR1-668.

**Acceptance Criteria**

- Addon-statistics logic (Fakturace table) is extracted from `ApiPartnerController` into a dedicated, standalone controller
- Existing admin API Partner → Statistiky screen renders unchanged (same columns, values, footnote text), backed by the new controller
- Shoptet Partner Portal's "Moje doplňky → Statistiky doplňků" screen — **Fakturace tab** — is implemented per Figma and served by the same controller
- Unit/integration tests cover the extracted controller

**Resources**

- Figma — Fakturace tab: https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=531-10086&m=dev
- Current implementation: `admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php`, `admin/react/src/Core/pages/ApiPartner/`
- Related: CZ3TDR1-668 (Použitelnost tab)
